cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Preferred Requirements
2-3 Years in Hematology
Leadership experience

cond_0051.intro: We are looking for a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist to join our team. The role involves performing laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified, and managing selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts. This may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing and reviewing procedures, and other assigned tasks. Work regularly involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens, which requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed area(s). Depending on the department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included, and additional hours may be required. The role follows laboratory policies and procedures, maintains quality control practices, and actively engages with customers and coworkers in a respectful and professional manner.
cond_0051.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assesses competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, and interviewing applicants; provides input for staff performance; oversees training and competency evaluations.
Assists laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a go-to resource and regularly addresses complex tests and procedures with staff and customers.
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing.
Assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, including general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation, inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed, biological specimen processing, cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces, quality control and calibration performance, and other pre-analytical activities.
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards.
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as institutional policies.
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients, communicating findings clearly to staff and clinical teams.
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership; regularly connects with new staff to support their development.
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolves customer service issues within guidelines, and supports education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested.
Facilitates workflow when necessary.
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Demonstrates understanding of and adheres to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training covering proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use, and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area.
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures; assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics and reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure smooth operation of the department or work area.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0051.requirements:
Technical skills and knowledge related to the laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the assigned department or work area.
Follows and ensures staff adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times.
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision.
Ability to maintain equipment and records and perform quality assessment activities.

Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT.

The position shares responsibility for managing selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training, advanced problem solving, equipment or computer maintenance, and writing or reviewing procedures. Work involves analytical testing of blood and human biological specimens and requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed areas. Depending on the department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included. The role follows laboratory policies and procedures, maintains quality control practices, and supports outstanding customer service while maintaining respectful relationships with all.
cond_0063.responsibilities:
Coordinates with management on staff scheduling and workflow assignments as requested.
Assesses competencies in accordance with Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Works with laboratory leadership on quality assessment, technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, staff performance input, and training and competency evaluations.
Supports laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results; serves as a shared resource for complex tests and procedures.
Coordinates instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Supports quality control and quality assurance testing alongside the team.
Assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Carries out assigned pre-analytical activities, which may include equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation, inventory control, specimen collection, biological specimen processing, cleaning and disinfection of equipment and spaces, quality control and calibration, and other pre-analytical tasks.
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for the assigned department or work area accurately and efficiently, following established procedures and competency standards.
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently following federal and state regulations and institutional policies.
Performs post-analytical activities, including reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provides and shares technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Supports orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, helps resolve customer service issues within guidelines, and supports education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested.
Helps facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follows appropriate safety policies including proper use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Demonstrates understanding of and adheres to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
May be responsible for transport of hazardous waste from point of generation to a designated secure storage area; will complete initial and refresher training on proper handling, transport, and PPE use and disposal.
Participates in laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Carries out various support activities to help the assigned department or work area run smoothly.
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures.
Assists in documenting and submitting required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics and reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to help ensure smooth department operation.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0063.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field.
National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist (e.g., ASCP, AAB, or AMT).
Two years of technical experience in a core lab.
Technical skills related to laboratory testing, procedures, and processes in the assigned department or work area.
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision.
Ability to maintain equipment and records and perform quality assessment activities.
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings.
Able to communicate effectively in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners, and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful and professional manner.
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and related documents.
Follows and ensures staff adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times.
Preferred Requirements
2–3 Years of experience in Hematology.
Leadership experience.

The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0154.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0154.requirements:
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
2-3 Years in Hematology is preferred
Leadership experience a plus
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT

cond_0264.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Is responsible for managing assigned selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control process, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre-and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively participates in outstanding customer service and accepts responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0264.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and addresses complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and Students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Facilitates workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0264.requirements:
Working knowledge of technical skills related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in the assigned department or work area
Familiarity with the Corporate Compliance Plan and applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; commitment to protecting patient confidentiality
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and carry out quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Able to communicate effectively in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful and professional manner
Basic computer skills and familiarity with Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and related documents
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field, or equivalent practical experience
Around two years of technical experience in a core lab, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience in the range of 2–3 years in Hematology is preferred
Some leadership experience is a plus
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT

cond_0270.intro: We are looking for a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist to join our team. This role works across assigned laboratory areas, coordinating with colleagues and leadership to support laboratory processes, quality control, and patient testing. The work involves analytical testing of blood and human biological specimens and requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed areas. Pre- and post-analytical work processes are included in the duties performed.
cond_0270.responsibilities:
Coordinates with lab management on staff scheduling and workflow assignments as requested.
Assesses staff competencies in accordance with Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Supports quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, and interviewing applicants; provides input for staff performance and assists with training and competency evaluations.
Assists laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results; serves as a shared resource for colleagues addressing complex tests and procedures.
Coordinates instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Supports quality control and quality assurance testing alongside the team.
Assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities, which may include equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation, inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed, biological specimen processing, cleaning and disinfection of laboratory equipment and spaces, quality control and calibration, and other pre-analytical activities.
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for the assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards.
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as institutional policies.
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Shares technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, working under the direction of lab leadership.
May act as a preceptor when supporting new staff and students as assigned.
Documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, helps resolve customer service issues within guidelines, and supports education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested.
Helps facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follows appropriate safety policies including proper use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Demonstrates understanding of and adheres to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
May be responsible for transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; required to complete initial and refresher training on proper handling, transport, and disposal of hazardous waste and personal protective equipment.
Participates in laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Performs various support activities to help with the operation of the assigned department or work area.
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures.
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics and reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to help ensure smooth operation of the department or work area.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0270.requirements:
Technical skills and aptitudes related to laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the assigned department or work area.
Follows and ensures staff adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all rules and regulations of applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times.
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision.
Ability to maintain equipment and records and perform quality assessment activities.
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings.
Able to communicate effectively in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners, and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful and professional manner.
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents.
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field.
Two years of technical experience in a core lab.
2–3 Years in Hematology is preferred.
Leadership experience a plus.
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT.

cond_0315.intro: We are looking for a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist to join our team. This role works alongside laboratory staff and leadership to carry out laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed or certified. The position shares responsibility for managing selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training, advanced problem solving, equipment or computer maintenance, and writing or reviewing procedures. Work involves analytical testing of blood and human biological specimens and requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed areas. Depending on the department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included. The role follows laboratory policies and procedures, maintains quality control practices, and supports outstanding customer service while maintaining respectful relationships with all.
cond_0315.responsibilities:
Coordinates with management on staff scheduling and workflow assignments as requested.
Assesses competencies in accordance with Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Works with laboratory leadership on quality assessment, technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, staff performance input, and training and competency evaluations.
Supports laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results; serves as a shared resource for complex tests and procedures.
Coordinates instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Supports quality control and quality assurance testing alongside the team.
Assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Carries out assigned pre-analytical activities, which may include equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation, inventory control, specimen collection, biological specimen processing, cleaning and disinfection of equipment and spaces, quality control and calibration, and other pre-analytical tasks.
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for the assigned department or work area accurately and efficiently, following established procedures and competency standards.
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently following federal and state regulations and institutional policies.
Performs post-analytical activities, including reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provides and shares technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Supports orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, helps resolve customer service issues within guidelines, and supports education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested.
Helps facilitate workflow when necessary.
Follows appropriate safety policies including proper use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Demonstrates understanding of and adheres to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
May be responsible for transport of hazardous waste from point of generation to a designated secure storage area; will complete initial and refresher training on proper handling, transport, and PPE use and disposal.
Participates in laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Carries out various support activities to help the assigned department or work area run smoothly.
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures.
Assists in documenting and submitting required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics and reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to help ensure smooth department operation.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0315.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field.
National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist (e.g., ASCP, AAB, or AMT).
Two years of technical experience in a core lab.
Technical skills related to laboratory testing, procedures, and processes in the assigned department or work area.
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision.
Ability to maintain equipment and records and perform quality assessment activities.
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings.
Able to communicate effectively in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners, and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful and professional manner.
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and related documents.
Follows and ensures staff adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times.
Preferred Requirements
2–3 Years of experience in Hematology.
Leadership experience.

cond_0322.intro:
We are looking for a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist to join our team.
[Company name masked] is seeking a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist who performs laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. This role is responsible for managing selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving, equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other assigned tasks. Work involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens, requiring a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures and maintains quality control practices.
cond_0322.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assesses competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Manages quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants; provides input for staff performance; oversees training and competency evaluations.
Assists laboratory management with special projects as assigned.
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a technical resource for complex tests/procedures.
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing.
Assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Performs assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking; specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities.
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards.
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as institutional policies.
Performs post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provides technical and support information related to laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Provides orientation and training to new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students.
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolves customer service issues within guidelines, and provides support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested.
Facilitates workflow when necessary.
Follows appropriate safety policies including the use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Demonstrates understanding of and adheres to the Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training covering proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use, and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area.
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures; assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports.
May perform supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure smooth operation of the department or work area.
Performs other duties as assigned.

cond_0335.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies

Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned

We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
The Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist performs various laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified. This role takes ownership of selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts, which may include workflow, quality control, performance improvement activities, training of new employees, advanced problem solving for customers and coworkers, department equipment or computer maintenance and upgrades, writing/reviewing procedures, or other tasks assigned. Work customarily involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens. Analytical laboratory testing generally requires a moderate to high degree of theoretical and practical knowledge and expertise in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are included in the work duties customarily performed; additional hours may also be required. Follows laboratory policies and procedures; maintains quality control practices in the Laboratory. Actively drives outstanding customer service and takes responsibility in maintaining relationships that are equally respectful to all.
cond_0341.responsibilities:
Assists with staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assess competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations
Directs quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, oversees training and competency evaluations
Assists the Laboratory management with special projects as assigned
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and resolves complex tests/procedures
Manages instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing
Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Executes assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities
Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as Institutional policies
Delivers post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients
Leads orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of the lab leadership
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned
Appropriately documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolution to customer service issues within guidelines, and support education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested
Drives workflow when necessary
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects, as assigned
Assists in the documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area
Performs other duties as assigned
cond_0341.requirements:
Technical skills and aptitudes related to the laboratory testing, procedures and processes performed in department or work area assigned
Follows and ensures adherence of staff, to the Corporate Compliance Plan and to all rules and regulations of all applicable local, state, and federal agencies and accrediting bodies; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Able to effectively communicate in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful, effective, and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office. Ability to operate computer systems in order to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
2-3 Years in Hematology is preferred
Leadership experience a plus
Must hold a national certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist such as ASCP, AAB, or AMT
cond_0341.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Performs all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards.

Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.

Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area.
Participates in the evaluation of new laboratory techniques and procedures. Assists with data collection and special projects as assigned.

cond_0510.requirements:

Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field.
National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist (e.g., ASCP, AAB, or AMT).
Two years of technical experience in a core lab.
Technical skills related to the laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the assigned department or work area.
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision.
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities.
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings.
Able to communicate clearly in verbal and written English with patients, staff, partners, and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful and professional manner — including explaining results, clarifying procedures, and handling questions from coworkers and customers.
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and other related documents.
Follows and ensures staff adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times.

2–3 Years of experience in Hematology.
Leadership experience.

cond_0584.intro: We are looking for a Lead Medical Laboratory Scientist to join our team. This role performs laboratory procedures in assigned areas as licensed/certified and takes ownership of selected aspects of laboratory processes or shifts. This includes directing workflow, quality control, performance improvement, training new employees, advanced problem solving, equipment and computer maintenance, and writing or reviewing procedures. Work involves analytical testing of blood and/or human biological specimens, requiring a solid level of theoretical and practical knowledge in licensed area(s). Depending on campus and department, various pre- and post-analytical work processes are part of the role. The position follows laboratory policies and procedures, maintains quality control practices, and is accountable for outstanding customer service and respectful relationships with all.
cond_0584.responsibilities:
Leads staff schedule preparation and workflow assignments as requested.
Assesses competencies according to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations.
Directs quality assessment and technical oversight, problem solving, scheduling, interviewing applicants, provides input for staff performance, and oversees training and competency evaluations.
Executes special projects assigned by laboratory management.
Reads, examines, and interprets complex test results. Serves as a resource and resolves complex tests/procedures.
Owns instrument maintenance and troubleshooting practices.
Leads quality control and quality assurance testing.
Drives data collection and special projects, as assigned.
Executes assigned pre-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, which may include general and analytical equipment maintenance, function checks and documentation; inventory control and supply stocking, specimen collection as needed; biological specimen processing; cleaning and disinfection of selected or assigned laboratory equipment and spaces; quality control and calibration performance; and other pre-analytical activities.
Delivers all expected tests and analytical procedures for assigned department or work area efficiently and accurately, according to established procedures, performance standards, and departmental competency standards.
Participates in proficiency testing, consistently adhering to federal and state regulations as well as institutional policies.
Executes post-analytical activities related to laboratory testing, reporting results (including highly abnormal results) in accordance with established procedures.
Provides and acts on technical and support information related to the elements of laboratory testing for all age groups, neonatal through geriatric patients.
Leads orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students as needed, under the direction of lab leadership.
May act as a preceptor when teaching new staff and students when assigned.
Documents orientation and training of new employees and medical technology students appropriately.
Provides guidance to technical and support staff, resolves customer service issues within guidelines, and delivers education to clinical staff as appropriate or requested.
Directs workflow when necessary.
Follows appropriate safety policies including the appropriate use of PPE, handwashing, and hazardous chemical handling.
Demonstrates understanding and adheres to Chemical Hygiene plan and Infection Control policies.
Employee job duties may include transport of hazardous waste from the point of generation to a designated secure storage area; employee will be required to complete initial training (prior to handling hazardous waste) and refresher training to include proper handling and transport of hazardous waste, and proper selection, use and disposal of personal protective equipment.
Participates in, and has knowledge of, laboratory and hospital Performance Improvement activities.
Performs various support activities to facilitate operation of assigned department or work area.
Evaluates new laboratory techniques and procedures. Drives data collection and special projects, as assigned.
Manages documentation and submission of required laboratory, departmental, and staff statistics/reports.
May perform Supervisor duties during extended absence of leadership to ensure the smooth operation of the department or work area.
Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0584.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a chemical, biological, or clinical laboratory science or medical technology field
National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist (e.g., ASCP, AAB, or AMT)
Two years of technical experience in a core lab
Technical skills related to the laboratory testing, procedures, and processes performed in the assigned department or work area
Ability to work independently and adapt to varying priorities, including directing workflow with minimal supervision
Ability to maintain equipment/records and perform quality assessment activities
Ability to educate and train new staff in medical laboratory settings
Able to effectively communicate verbally and in written English with patients, staff, partners, and customers of varied backgrounds in a respectful and professional manner
Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office; ability to operate computer systems to maintain patient documentation, testing records, and related documents
Follows and ensures staff adherence to the Corporate Compliance Plan and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations and accrediting body requirements; protects confidentiality of patient information and results at all times
Preferred Requirements
2–3 Years of experience in Hematology
Leadership experience
